y0knswrc.baseName: Christmas Tree World 3ft Gold Flower Fibre Optic Tree
y0knswrc.variantName: Christmas Tree World 3ft Gold Flower Fibre Optic Tree
y0knswrc.sourceDescription: Looking to add a touch of glamour to your festivities this year? With the 3ft Gold Flower fibre optic Christmas tree, you're in dazzlingly good company. Featuring festive gold foliage, tinsel branch tips and warm white multifunction lighting, you get a full chandelier-effect gold fibre optic in a pint-sized package! As the gold fibres are splayed delicately across the tree, every inch of the tree lights up with a magical display of dancing lights. It's a perfect tree for delivering the wow-factor on a budget. There is also no need to worry about Christmas tree lights or Xmas decorations with our 3ft Gold Flower fibre optic trees. In fact, all of our fibre optic trees come pre-lit and many are adorned with a stunning tree topper, so all you need to do is plug in and watch the magic come to life! Product Features • Size: 3ft • Number of Branch Tips: 80 PVC branch tips • Next-gen effects: Beautiful Warm White fibre lighting effects • Tree Width: 45cm diameter • No moving parts: Silent operation • Functions: Multifunctional • Foliage colour: Festive Gold • Easy assembly: Attached Branches • Sturdy base: Attractive plastic pot • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor Use Only • Mains powered, 1.85m lead length • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

wkcz7rnh.variantName: GloBrite 4ft Pre-Lit White Birch Twig Christmas Tree with 72 LEDs
wkcz7rnh.sourceDescription: Create an elegant festive display with the GloBrite 4ft Pre-Lit White Birch Twig Christmas Tree. Featuring 72 warm white LEDs, this decorative tree provides a soft and welcoming glow for Christmas displays and seasonal decorating. Measuring 97 cm (D) × 46 cm (W) × 42 cm (H), the flexible branches can be gently shaped to suit your preferred arrangement, while the included ground pegs help provide added stability when used outdoors. Designed for both indoor and outdoor settings, the pre-lit construction makes decorating quick and convenient. Its simple white birch-style finish provides a versatile look that complements hallways, living rooms, entrances, patios and other festive spaces. 4FT PRE-LIT TWIG TREE: A decorative 4ft Christmas twig tree designed to create an elegant seasonal feature in indoor and outdoor spaces. 72 WARM WHITE LEDS: Pre-installed LED lights provide a warm white glow to create a cosy and welcoming festive atmosphere. BENDABLE BRANCHES: Flexible branches can be shaped and adjusted to create your preferred decorative arrangement and display. INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: Suitable for decorating living spaces, entrances, patios and other appropriate festive areas around the home. GROUND PEGS INCLUDED: Supplied with pegs to help provide additional stability when positioning the tree in suitable outdoor locations. EASY FESTIVE SETUP: The pre-lit design reduces decorating time and provides an illuminated Christmas display with minimal preparation. Read the instructions before use. Dreibach LTD, Unit 2 Capital Business Park, Manaor Way, WD6 1GW, United Kingdom.

9qhesqtp.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Mini Lights Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
9qhesqtp.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Mini Lights Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
9qhesqtp.sourceDescription: This Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree redefines seasonal décor with its realistic appearance and innovative design, transforming any living space into a festive haven. Its modern style and lifelike leaf arrangement make it a captivating centerpiece for homes during the holiday season while maintaining a sleek, minimal aesthetic. Crafted with simplicity and functionality in mind, this tree is easily assembled, blending seamlessly into various décor styles and imbuing environments with the warmth and joy synonymous with Christmas. Materials: Crafted from high-grade PVC and steel, offering durability and a realistic look. The materials ensure the tree withstands multiple seasons while retaining its visual appeal. This blend not only adds to the longevity but also enhances the visual aesthetics of the tree, making it look lush and full. Included Components: Equipped with decorative string lights that seamlessly adorn the tree, providing a warm white glow that enhances its natural look. Coupled with a reliable metal stand that ensures the tree stays upright and stable throughout the festive season. Features /Function /Design: The hinged construction allows for quick setup and disassembly, saving both time and effort. The lifelike tips give it a fresh, full appearance, while the foldable stand provides convenience for storage and stability in use. Recommended Uses: Perfect for living rooms, this tree can complement a variety of home decors, enhancing the holiday spirit. It transforms spaces with its decorative lights and creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions for optimal stability. Ensure the LED lights are handled with care to maintain their function and longevity. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 104 cm Stand size: 35 cm Hinged construction for set up, Lifelike Tips, Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 519 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Cable length: 200 cm Indoor use only Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED stringlight 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

mpvhzpqx.baseName: Neo 50cm Pre-Lit Artificial Fir Christmas Wreath with Warm White LED Lights
mpvhzpqx.variantName: Neo 50cm Pre-Lit Artificial Fir Christmas Wreath with Warm White LED Lights
mpvhzpqx.sourceDescription: Bring a traditional festive touch to your home with the Neo 50cm Pre-Lit Christmas Wreath, featuring full artificial evergreen foliage and integrated warm white LED lights. Designed to create an attractive seasonal display, the layered evergreen tips give the wreath a full appearance while the warm lighting adds a welcoming glow. Measuring 50cm in diameter, the wreath is an eye-catching size for displaying on doors, walls and other suitable areas around the home. It features 20 integrated warm white LED lights, evenly positioned throughout the foliage to illuminate the wreath and enhance your Christmas decorations. The battery-operated design provides greater flexibility when choosing where to display the wreath, with no mains power connection or trailing power cable required. Simply add the required AA batteries and position the wreath in your chosen location. Made with artificial foliage, the wreath requires no ongoing maintenance and can be carefully stored after Christmas ready to be displayed again the following festive season. Its classic green foliage and warm white lighting make it easy to coordinate with a wide variety of Christmas decorations. Dimensions: H50 x W50 x D50 cm Product Specifications: Product Type: Pre-Lit Christmas Wreath Diameter: 50cm Colour: Green Number of Lights: 20 LEDs Light Colour: Warm White Foliage: Artificial Evergreen Tips Power Source: Battery Operated Battery Type: AA Batteries Pre-Lit: Yes Reusable: Yes Suitable For: Doors, walls and festive home displays Seasonal Use: Christmas Warning: for decorative use only. This product is not a toy. Keep out of reach of young children and pets, as small decorative components may become detached and present a choking hazard. Keep away from open flames, candles and other direct heat sources. For pre-lit wreaths, use only the specified battery type and ensure batteries are inserted with the correct polarity. Do not mix old and new batteries or different battery types. Remove batteries before long-term storage and dispose of used batteries appropriately. Do not use the wreath if the lights, battery compartment or wiring are damaged. Ensure the wreath is securely mounted before display and regularly check for loose or damaged components. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom
